name: crab-farm
description: A living pixel farm beside Claude Code: each step Claude works on gets its own named crab on its own plot, every tool call is an errand, subagents are mini helpers, and finished work earns coins that build up the farm. Desktop, VS Code and the terminal; /farm stats tells it anywhere. Purely visual: no model calls, no tools, no network, no usage.

motion.title: Farm motion
motion.description: full, calm (no walking about between jobs), or still (a still picture that changes as the work does)

hemisphere.title: Seasons
hemisphere.description: auto follows your time zone; north or south sets it

hover.title: Hover details
hover.description: Show a card when you hover a crab, a plot or a building (desktop app and VS Code)

terminalStyle.title: Terminal farm
terminalStyle.description: pixels draws the farm in the terminal; text keeps the 1.2 list of steps

spinnerWords.title: Farm words in the spinner
spinnerWords.description: Off by default. On, the working spinner says the farm's job (Watering, Tilling) instead of its own word
